data_migrations: The database moves from schema v39 → 40 to hold your own glossary entries and your notes on built-in figures. Nothing in your library changes.

added: Schema v40 adds the user_glossary_entries and figure_notes tables, with UserGlossaryRepository and FigureNoteRepository. Both tables are classified shareable.
A backup carries the user's glossary entries and figure notes in an app.glossary section, and is stamped backupVersion 2 only when that section has something in it.
